title: Protocol for mouse trophoblast stem cell isolation, differentiation, and cytokine detection
protocol: Prepare 4- or 24-well plates with γ-irradiated MEFs by seeding 5 × 10^4 cells/well in 0.5 mL TS medium the day before blastocyst collection.
Collect 3.5 DPC blastocysts from uterus by flushing under sterile conditions.
Cut across cervix using fine scissors to remove uterus from pregnant mouse.
Hold cervix with forceps and separate uterine horns by cutting mesometrium.
Insert a 26-gauge needle in the upper part of uterus near oviduct and flush each horn with 1-2 mL of TS + F4H medium toward cervix.
Change medium of 4- or 24-well plates with feeder cells using 0.5 mL of TS + F4H medium.
Transfer each blastocyst into a single well of a 4- or 24-well plate containing TS + F4H medium.
Incubate at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Monitor the blastocyst for attachment and hatching on day 1 without changing the medium.
On day 2, monitor the embryo for outgrowth and carefully remove medium.
Add fresh 0.5 mL TS + F4H medium.
If outgrowth is loosely attached, remove only half of the medium and add 0.25 mL fresh TS + F4H medium.
Monitor outgrowth size from day 3 to day 5.
Disaggregate outgrowth when it reaches around 0.8 mm in the same well.
Wash cells two times with 0.5 mL PBS.
Aspirate PBS and add 100 μL of 0.25% Trypsin.
Incubate for 5 min at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Thoroughly disaggregate outgrowth using P200 pipet by mixing up and down.
Stop trypsin action by immediate addition of 0.5 mL 70cond + 1.5× F4H medium.
Culture cells at 37°C and 5% CO2 for 16 h.
Replace medium with fresh 70cond + F4H medium.
Change the 70cond + F4H medium every other day.
Monitor closely for colony formation.
Prepare 4- or 24-well plates with γ-irradiated MEFs by seeding 5 × 10^4 cells/well in 0.5 mL TS medium 1 day prior to colony picking.
Change the medium of feeders with 0.5 mL TS + 1.5× F4H medium and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 on the day of TS cell colony picking.
Aspirate the medium from the plate containing TS cell colonies.
Wash the cells with PBS two times.
Add 0.5 mL PBS to the cells without removing it.
Pick TS cell colonies using a P20 pipette with white tips under the dissecting microscope.
Transfer each picked colony along with PBS into a single well of a 96 well plate.
Add 50 μL of 0.25% trypsin to each well and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 5 minutes.
Add 150 μL of TS + 1.5× F4H medium to stop the action of trypsin and dissociate cells by pipetting up and down in each well.
Transfer each clone from the 96 well plate to a 4- or 24-well plate prepared according to step 9.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 16 hours.
After incubation, add fresh 0.5 mL TS + 1.5× F4H medium.
Change the medium every other day with 0.5 mL of fresh TS + 1× F4H medium until colonies reappear.
Passage the TS cells once they appear 50%–60% confluent.
Prepare 6-well plates with γ-irradiated MEFs by seeding 2 × 10^5 cells per well in 2.0 mL TS medium the day prior to passaging TS cells.
Remove TS medium from wells on the day of passaging and add 1.5 mL TS + 1.5× F4H medium.
Wash the TS cells once with 0.5 mL PBS.
Add 100 μL of 0.25% Trypsin to dissociate the cells for 5 min at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Stop trypsin action by adding 0.5 mL TS + 1.5× F4H medium immediately.
Dissociate cells to single cells using a 1.0 mL pipette set at 400 μL.
Transfer all cells to the 6-well plate containing γ-irradiated MEFs and culture at 37°C, 5% CO2 for 16 h.
Add fresh 2.0 mL TS + 1.0× F4H medium to each well after 16 hours.
Change the medium (TS + 1.0× F4H) every other day until TS cells reach 60%-80% confluence.
Passage each clone 2 to 3 times at a 1:6 ratio as mentioned in previous steps to obtain stable TS cell clones.
Once stable clones are established, wash the TS cells once with 2.5 mL PBS.
Add 500 μL of 0.25% Trypsin for 5 min at 37°C with 5% CO2 to dissociate cells.
Stop trypsin action by adding 2.5 mL TS medium immediately after the incubation period.
Disaggregate cells by pipetting up and down using a pipette.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL tube.
Centrifuge the suspension for 5 minutes at 200 × g.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 10 mL of 70cond + F4H medium.
Seed cells in a 100 mm dish and incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for 45 minutes.
Collect floating TS cells from the 100 mm dish.
Count the collected cells.
Seed 1 × 10^5 cells in 2 mL of 70cond + F4H medium in a single well of a tissue culture grade 6-well plate.
Passage cells 2 to 3 times to obtain a pure TS cell population.
Validate TS cell identity using the CDX2 marker with immunofluorescence.
Grow isolated TS cell clones without MEFs in a 30 mm dish on a glass cover slip in 70cond + F4H medium for 48 hours.
Fix cells in 4% paraformaldehyde.
Perform immunofluorescence using anti-CDX2 antibody.
Stain DNA with DAPI.
Prepare 1× freezing mix and keep on ice.
Harvest TS cells from 60%–80% confluent culture by trypsinization and pellet cells by centrifugation.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend cells in 5 mL TS medium.
Count the cells and pellet again by centrifugation.
Discard the supernatant (leave 100 μL) and resuspend the pellet by tapping.
Slowly add 1× freezing mix to the cells (2 × 10^5 cells per 1 mL freezing mix).
Mix gently and aliquot 0.5 mL of the cell suspension per cryovial.
Transfer tubes to cryogenic freezing container and place in −80°C freezer for 16–18 h.
Transfer cryotubes to a liquid nitrogen container for long term storage.
Seed 2 × 10^5 γ-irradiated MEFs in a 30 mm dish with 2 mL TS medium on the day before thawing TS cells.
Quickly thaw a frozen vial of TS cells in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer thawed TS cells to 10 mL of TS medium and centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 2 mL TS + 1× F4H medium.
Transfer cells on γ-irradiated MEFs prepared in step 24a and incubate at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Change the medium the next day and keep changing it every other day with TS + 1× F4H medium until confluency reaches 60%–80%.
Thaw TS cells onto MEF feeders to avoid differentiation.
Alternatively, thaw TS cells in 70cond + 1.5 × F4H medium without feeders and expect some differentiation in the first passage after thawing.
Harvest feeder free TS cells from a culture that is 60%–80% confluent by trypsinization and count the cells.
Seed 1 × 10^5 cells in 10 mL of 70cond + F4H medium for a 100 mm dish (or 1 × 10^4 cells for a 30 mm dish).
After 24 hours, remove the medium and wash TS cells twice with 10 mL PBS.
Add 10 mL TS differentiation medium.
Perform various treatments either just after addition of TS medium or after two days of differentiation.
Incubate cells at 37°C, 5% CO2.
Seal the plates with parafilm and place the plate inside γ-irradiator.
Give doses such as 0 Gy, 0.5 Gy, 10 Gy, or 30 Gy for inducing DNA damage.
Change TS medium every other day.
Add a DNA damage response inhibitor such as caffeine, ATM inhibitor KU55933, or ATR inhibitor VE821.
Keep one plate as a control without any treatment and change TS medium every other day.
Collect cells every 2 days after treatment until the 8th day of differentiation.
Disaggregate differentiated TS cells with TrypLE express enzyme in a 100 mm dish.
Incubate for 10–20 min at 37°C.
Inactivate TrypLE with 10 ml TS medium.
Pipette up and down to disaggregate cells.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 200 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash cells with PBS twice.
Store the pellet at −80°C for further analysis.
Induce DNA damage with 10 Gy γ-irradiation.
Inhibit the DNA damage response with an ATR inhibitor either just after addition of differentiation TS medium or 2 days after differentiation.
Fix cells in 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 min.
Stain fixed cells with 0.01% crystal violet for 60 min.
Wash stained cells with water.
Dry the treated cells.
Image the treated cells.
Lysate cells in TRizol to isolate RNA.
Treat isolated RNA with DNase to digest residual genomic DNA.
Perform reverse transcription on the treated RNA.
Run PCR using specific primers and a negative “no template” control.
Separate PCR products on a 2% agarose gel along with a 100 bp DNA ladder.
Grow the cells in a 30 mm dish with bottom cover slip.
Fix the cells for 10 min with 2 mL 4% paraformaldehyde at 22°C–25°C.
Wash cells three times with 2 mL PBS.
Add 2 mL permeabilization buffer to the dish for 10 min to permeabilize cells.
Wash cells three times with 2 mL PBS.
Add 2 mL 1× PBSTB blocking solution and incubate at 22°C–25°C for 1 h.
Dilute the primary antibody in 1× PBSTB and add to the cells.
Incubate primary antibody 16-18 h at 4°C.
Remove the primary antibody and wash the cells with 2 mL 1× PBSTB three times each for 10 min.
Dilute the secondary antibody in 1× PBSTB and add to the cells.
Incubate the cells with the secondary antibody for 1 h at 22°C–25°C in the dark.
Wash the cells with 2 mL 1× PBSTB three times each for 10 min.
Mount the cells with a coverslip using DAPI.
Record images using a LSM780 confocal microscope within 1 week and collect Z-stacks.
Lysed cells using TRIzol to isolate RNA.
Digested 1 μg of total RNA with RQ1 RNase-free DNase (1 U) for 20 min at 37°C in 1× RQ1 RNase-free DNase reaction buffer.
Stopped DNase action by adding RQ1 RNase-free DNase stop solution and incubating for 10 min at 65°C.
Added 1 μL each of oligo (dT) and dNTPs to the DNase digested RNA sample and incubated for 5 min at 65°C.
Kept RNA sample on ice for 2 min before adding cDNA synthesis mix which contains buffer, reverse transcriptase, RNase inhibitor, and DTT.
Incubated samples for 60 min at 50°C to synthesize cDNA and inactivated enzymes for 5 min at 85°C.
Added 1 μL RNase H and incubated for 20 min at 37°C.
Took 1 μL of cDNA and performed PCR with TS cell marker primers such as Pl1, Pl2, Plf, and 18S rRNA.
Washed placental cells with PBS.
Added fresh 1.2 mL TS medium to the washed cells.
Incubated the cells for 24 h at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment.
Collected the supernatant from the incubated cells.
Centrifuged the supernatant at 200 × g for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube and discard the pellet consisting of floating cells.
Store the supernatant at −80°C for further analysis such as measuring secreted cytokines, hormones, and other enzymes.
Add 500 μL of TrypLE express enzyme and incubate at 37°C for 10–20 min to disaggregate attached cells from the 30 mm dish.
Inactivate TrypLE by adding 2 mL of TS medium and pipette up and down to disaggregate all cells.
Transfer the cells to an Eppendorf tube and centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 min.
Wash the pellet two times with PBS.
Store the pellet at −80°C for further analysis such as measuring non-secreted cytokines and enzymes.
